analytics_collection_enabled.description: Enable Firebase Analytics collection for the mobile app.

crashlytics_collection_enabled.description: Enable Firebase Crashlytics collection for the mobile app.

rewarded_ads_enabled.description: Feature flag for rewarded ads in the mobile app.

minimum_supported_version_code.description: Minimum Android versionCode allowed before showing a forced update flow.

remote_balance_enabled.description: Reserved flag for future remote balance tuning. Do not use as an authoritative economy control.
